Name: schema-export
Description: A schema export file is ready to download, or the export failed. Sent to the user who started the export, also when that user has left the page.
ConsumerAppRecommendation: Listen on "schema-export" on the Notifier hub; the payload carries ids only, so re-read the record with the user's token; keep a slow poll of the job status as fallback, and stop waiting when this arrives.
ConsumerAppNote: Mostly portal: sent when the schema action is started from the Blocks portal or by an app that calls the same Blocks data API.
